purpose: state what the system must do in testable terms that stakeholders agree on
entry_criteria: Business goals and stakeholders are identified
procedure: Elicit needs from each stakeholder group through interviews, observation and existing documents.
Write each requirement as one verifiable statement of behavior with a unique id and a source.
Add acceptance criteria that a tester could check, including error and edge cases.
Resolve conflicts and duplicates with the stakeholders; record decisions and rejected requests.
Prioritize with the product owner and trace each requirement to a business objective.
Baseline the set and manage later changes through a recorded process.
deliverables: requirements list with ids and sources
acceptance_criteria: Each requirement is a single testable statement
Each has a source and acceptance criteria
validation_method: Stakeholder review and product owner approval of the baseline.

validation.check: ask a tester to write one test from each of five random requirements
validation.expect: tests can be written without questions

validation.check: check each requirement traces to an objective

failure_modes.detection: Words like fast or easy with no measure
Requirements differ from baseline without record

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The requirement says a signed-in user can export their orders as CSV within 30 seconds for up to 10,000 orders, with an error message if the limit is exceeded; a tester writes three tests from it.
